named_subject: ocean waves (a set of four or five wavy and zigzag line strokes)
action: The wave strokes enter from the left, cropped at first, then slide rightward and grow slightly larger while a horizon line appears near the top in the later frames.
identity_gap: From frame 5 on the black strokes match the doodle's five lines and their angles closely, but in frames 1-4 the group is cut off at the left edge and the top stroke is drawn with a different shape, so it reads as the doodle only after frame 5.
notes: Between frames 4 and 5 the whole character jumps in position and the top stroke changes shape, and at frame 11 a horizon line appears abruptly two frames before the film shows its horizon; after frame 5 the character only drifts and scales as a rigid group, while the film shows waves rising and breaking. The change that would help most is to make the individual wave strokes rise, crest and fall in step with the film's waves instead of sliding the whole drawing as one block.
